verdicts.reason: Both break the same way. The orange tint is gone and the background is murky and dark. The white frame has shrunk to a meaningless grid box, the play-arrow icon is blown up into a competing focal point, and an empty orange rectangle sits there as a stray block, so the original's framed, centred identity is lost. A's 'Music and lyrics by Leland Carroll' credit is tiny and hard to read. B's text is larger and more legible, though the credit wraps over four lines and 'RICHMOND' is left alone on its own line in the tickets text, so B is only slightly less bad.
